content.title: Where to watch Barcelona vs. Atletico Madrid LaLiga match today on free streams, TV
content.text: Barcelona's Marc Bernal celebrates after scoring his side's second goal during the Champions League round of 16, second leg soccer match between FC Barcelona and Newcastle United FC in Barcelona, Spain, Wednesday, March 18, 2026. (AP Photo/Joan Monfort)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Dustin Hockensmith | dhockensmith@pennlive.comThe match of the day in Spanish LaLiga play goes down Saturday in Madrid, where fourth-place Atletico Madrid takes a swing at league leader Barcelona. The match is scheduled to start at 3 p.m. ET with TV coverage on ESPN Deportes and multiple options for streaming on-demand.How to watch Barcelona vs. Atletico Madrid LaLiga on TV and stream without cable:When: Saturday, April 4 at 3 p.m. ETWhere: Riyadh Air Metropolitano, Madrid, SpainTV channel: ESPN Deportes and ESPN+Streaming on: FuboTV (free trial) | DirecTV (free trial) | SlingTV (low intro rate) | ESPN Unlimited ($29.99/mo.) | ESPN+ ($12.99/mo.)Barcelona vs. Atletico Madrid LaLiga: The matchupBarcelona goes into Riyadh Air Metropolitano as a narrow betting favorite (+115) on the road and looking to maintain its four-point lead over Real Madrid at the start of Saturday’s contests. Barca has been rolling of late with a 7-1-0 record and an average of 3.1 goals per match over its past eight, improving 24-1-4 with 73 points in LaLiga play, but losing the Spanish Copa del Rey (4-3) on aggregate to this Atletico Madrid side with a 4-0 in the first leg and a 3-0 win in the second. Atletico Madrid found a way to advance in Champions League play in the same fashion, by beating the English Premier League’s Tottenham Hotspur 5-2 in the first leg and absorbing a 3-2 loss in the second to advance 7-5 on aggregate. Last time out, Atletico was game for a fight in a 3-2 loss to Real Madrid where the game-winning goal was scored on a penalty in the 72nd minute. Barcelona vs. Atletico Madrid LaLiga : Know your live streamsFuboTV (free trial): FuboTV offers the most extensive package of live sports with rates competitive with DirecTV. The FuboTV Pro ($48.99 first month), Elite ($53.99) and Deluxe ($73.99) all come with first-month discounts. Monthly rates rise to $73.99, $83.99 and $103.99 after the first-month discount.DirecTV (free trial): DirecTV offers a 5-day free trial and a total of $30 off over the first three full months for the Choice Package, which includes 125-plus channels and access to ESPN Unlimited, a $29.99 standalone value featuring all ESPN channels and ESPN+.SlingTV (low intro rate): First full month of streaming runs as low as $29.99 with current offer for 50% off Sling’s Orange & Blue Plan. Day passes are also available for 24 hours ($4.99), as well as three-day ($9.99) and seven-day access ($14.99).ESPN Unlimited ($29.99 bundle): ESPN has a new, standalone package that includes ABC broadcasts, all of ESPN’s sports channels, and access to ESPN+. For a limited time, ESPN can be bundled with Disney Plus and Hulu for $29.99 per month. This package is included free in select FuboTV and DirecTV plans, along with other TV providers.
